subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-11-12
html:
Found and fixed a live trust bug: the /services/solo-business-owner page — including its own FAQPage structured data — was telling buyers and AI crawlers that Meta, Shopify, Stripe, and an email tool are connectable on the Solo plan today. Per catalog.ts, all four are still "coming soon" (not live). Rank still flat (29th straight session, 0/22 tracked keywords); backlinks actually ticked down 3/2 → 2/1 this week — traced to futurlabs.dev's own /built-by-us page losing its link to Arlo to a redirect on their side (nothing to action in this repo; flagged for a human look over there).

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/services/solo-business-ownerRewrote the meta description, OG/Twitter tags, SoftwareApplication JSON-LD description, hero subhead, "how it works" step, two feature bullets, a "what you can ask" example, the setup-section copy, and the FAQPage JSON-LD answer to "Which platforms can I connect on Solo?" — all now correctly split "live today" (GA4, Search Console, Google Ads) from "coming soon" (Meta, Shopify, Stripe, email).AI-answer-engine accuracy + Solo-plan signup expectations (no single keyword)askarlo.app/services/solo-business-owner — view page source, search for "coming soon" and application/ld+json

Why this and not more FOCUS-cluster content: the connector matrix (5/5) and comparison hub (5/5) are re-confirmed fully built for a 12th straight session — nothing new to ship there. Re-auditing a shipped persona page against the connector catalog's actual live/coming-soon status (the same approach that caught the fabricated pricing schema on 11-09) turned up a real structured-data accuracy bug instead. A prospect — or an AI engine answering on this page's behalf — asking "can I connect Shopify on Solo" would get told yes today; that's now fixed.

Next: confirmed src/content/services.ts and its dynamic [slug]/page.tsx route are dead code for all 6 personas (each has its own static route that always wins) — flagged for deletion, not touched this session. The other 5 persona pages were spot-checked for the same overclaim and came back clean. FOCUS cluster and both gated connector/destination catalogs stay exhausted. Everything else open (GSC sitemap submission, off-page listings, AI Result Tracker LLM engine config, CSP, www redirect, second testimonial, the futurlabs.dev backlink, ChatGPT-connector verification) remains a human decision.
